title: Look at spread
summary: Spread describes how far apart values are. The range subtracts the smallest value from the largest. It is a simple start, not a full description.
introduction: Spread describes how far apart values are. The range subtracts the smallest value from the largest. It is a simple start, not a full description. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Spread describes how far apart values are. The range subtracts the smallest value from the largest. It is a simple start, not a full description.
The output is 4 because 10 minus 6 is 4. This shows the distance between the extremes.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Compare with [6, 6, 10, 10], which has the same range.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Two lists can have the same range and very different middle values.
For more detail later, use this [Data Science further reading](https://www.openintro.org/book/ims/).
